protocol_change_from_design: Replace the proposed additive RAW-minus-market challenger with one prespecified 14-input challenger containing the RAW-minus-market logit and its six interactions with the existing microstructure features. Do not fit or score the additive version.
hypothesis_origin: Exploratory development hypothesis informed by prior analysis; no holdout evaluation or selection is permitted.

fit.label_release_boundary: strictly before the first test decision

scaling.main_effects: Fit one StandardScaler on the seven control inputs plus raw_minus_market_logit using training rows only; use the same transformed seven control columns for C and X.
scaling.interactions: For each microstructure feature z_j, multiply standardized raw_minus_market_logit by standardized z_j; fit a separate StandardScaler on the six training interaction columns only.
scaling.evaluation: Apply the saved training scalers without refitting.
scaling.constant_columns: Retain all prespecified columns. StandardScaler maps constant training columns to zero with scale 1; record and report those columns.

evaluation.input_calendar: Rows are qualified from decision-time inputs only; outcome-release availability does not change historical decision eligibility.
evaluation.quality_sample: The shared complete-input rows with official binary target labels released no later than the exclusive development cutoff.

bootstrap.method: paired circular moving-block bootstrap over the complete UTC calendar, including days without qualifying rows
bootstrap.empty_replicates: Count and exclude from metric intervals.
bootstrap.one_class_replicates: Retain for log loss and Brier; mark AUC undefined and count explicitly.

economics.common_calendar: The same evaluation-period rows with all six decision-time microstructure inputs and valid RAW and market probabilities; preserve calendar days with no eligible rows for daily summaries and bootstrap.
economics.policy: Existing independent fixed-$5 gross order policy; each probability variant selects its own side and trades.
economics.decision_time: T-60, using only the saved T-60 snapshot
economics.execution_time: T-59, using only the saved T-59 snapshot to execute the already selected side
economics.fees_depth_and_settlement: Use the existing causal execution engine and saved fee, depth, and official-market history; preserve cash debit separately from outcome-share fees and collateral cash fees.
economics.settlement_cutoff: Only outcomes whose official label release is no later than 2026-07-01T00:00:00Z are settled in primary PnL; later positions remain unresolved and are reported separately.
economics.raw_reference: Restrict the existing RAW BASE70 decisions and trade ledger to the exact shared calendar before any aggregation; do not compare with its full-calendar PnL.
economics.paired_daily_pnl_bootstrap: Use the same full evaluation UTC calendar, including zero-trade days, and paired 3-day circular blocks.

availability_audit.source_event_presence: Report observed replay events separately from hourly source files marked available or processed; empty processed partitions do not establish observed book coverage.
availability_audit.crossed_book_policy: Inspect reconstruction semantics and code; retain existing validity checks and do not relax them to increase coverage.
